The **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** is a degree-completion program focused on management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects.

- Offered **full-time or part-time**, **in person at the Burnaby campus**
- Covers construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, professional standards, Liberal Studies, and management electives
- Example courses include **CMGT 7190 – Construction Planning and Controls**, **CMGT 7330 – Finance for Construction Managers**, and **CMGT 7535 – Leadership and Interpersonal Skills**
- The curriculum includes at least **4 credits from the approved management-elective pool** and **12 Liberal Studies credits**
- The capstone sequence includes **CMGT 8700 – Industry Based Project Proposal**, followed by a choice of **CMGT 8800 – Industry Based Project** or **CMGT 8810 – Industry Based Project**

[View the program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)

The **Construction Management Bachelor of Technology** is a degree-completion program focused on management, technical, and interpersonal skills for construction projects.

- Offered **full-time or part-time**, **in person at the Burnaby campus**
- Covers construction controls, organizational management, stakeholder engagement, professional standards, Liberal Studies, and management electives

Before applying, you must complete an **approved departmental pre-entry assessment**. You also need **English Studies 12 at 73% or an accepted equivalent**, plus exactly one of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma or degree with at least **67% GPA**, plus **1 year** of construction-industry experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree and the **BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate**, each at **67%**, plus **1 year** of experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree at **67%**, plus **8 years** of North American construction-management experience in mid- or senior-level roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, an accepted Math 11 option at **60%**, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at **67%**, and **1 year** of experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

A master’s degree alone does not qualify. Certain credentials earned outside Canada, the US, UK, Australia, or New Zealand require an accepted comprehensive course-by-course evaluation with GPA calculation.

Your best first step is arranging the pre-entry assessment and confirming which pathway applies to you. [View admission details](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)

Is it full-time or part-time?
It is offered **Full-time and Part-time**.
What should I know before applying?

Before applying, you must complete an **approved departmental pre-entry assessment**. You also need **English Studies 12 at 73% or an accepted equivalent**, plus exactly one of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma or degree with at least **67% GPA**, plus **1 year** of construction-industry experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree and the **BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate**, each at **67%**, plus **1 year** of experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree at **67%**, plus **8 years** of North American construction-management experience in mid- or senior-level roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, an accepted Math 11 option at **60%**, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at **67%**, and **1 year** of experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

A master’s degree alone does not qualify. Certain credentials earned outside Canada, the US, UK, Australia, or New Zealand require an accepted comprehensive course-by-course evaluation with GPA calculation.

Your best first step is arranging the pre-entry assessment and confirming which pathway applies to you. [View admission details](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
What about international applicants?

International applicants are accepted for both **full-time and part-time** study. However, availability can vary by intake or study mode.

The program is listed as **eligible to apply for a Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP)**, but study-permit details are not published in the program record and should be confirmed with BCIT International.

[View the program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
Does that guarantee admission?
No. Admission cannot be guaranteed; it depends on the applicable decision process and your circumstances.

- Approval of the departmental pre-entry assessment and which admission pathway applies to you.
- Whether your credential is recognized and considered construction-related, and whether your work experience meets the required field, region, and responsibility level.
- Acceptance of English-language equivalents or an international credential evaluation.
- Current intake or study-mode availability and any study-permit requirements.
- The final admission decision; meeting minimum requirements does not guarantee admission.

Confirm these with BCIT Admissions or International Student Services: [Construction Management program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/).

Before applying, you must complete an **approved departmental pre-entry assessment**. You also need **English Studies 12 at 73% or an accepted equivalent**, plus exactly one of these entry pathways:

conversation.content: What should I know before applying?

Before applying, you must complete an **approved departmental pre-entry assessment**. You also need **English Studies 12 at 73% or an accepted equivalent**, plus exactly one of these entry pathways:

- Construction-related diploma or degree with at least **67% GPA**, plus **1 year** of construction-industry experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree and the **BCIT Construction Operations Associate Certificate**, each at **67%**, plus **1 year** of experience.
- Unrelated diploma or degree at **67%**, plus **8 years** of North American construction-management experience in mid- or senior-level roles.
- An approved Red Seal trade, an accepted Math 11 option at **60%**, the Construction Operations Associate Certificate at **67%**, and **1 year** of experience beyond apprenticeship hours.

A master’s degree alone does not qualify. Certain credentials earned outside Canada, the US, UK, Australia, or New Zealand require an accepted comprehensive course-by-course evaluation with GPA calculation.

Your best first step is arranging the pre-entry assessment and confirming which pathway applies to you. [View admission details](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/construction-management-bachelor-of-technology-full-time-part-time-8800btech/)
What about international applicants?
